question: Does existing persisted data from the published run cover pre-archive discards?
answer: NO — only post-archive discards are persisted. The discard logger (PolyForge/env/discardlog.py) is new in v1.5 and was NOT present during the published run, so the published run left no structured trace of candidates discarded BEFORE archiving.

what_the_published_run_persisted.note: These are the ARCHIVED discards: a candidate/record that was written or compared and then removed with a certificate.

pre_archive_discards_NOT_persisted_by_pu: same_skeleton_worse (a worse candidate on an existing skeleton — never written, never archived)
lemma_protected (replacement blocked because the incumbent is a used lemma)
replace_blocked_kept_both (v1.4.6 §5.2 keep-both: the new did not entail the old)

name_only_pruned_published_claim.claim: 0 published records pruned by name-only (parameter-blind) property matching.
name_only_pruned_published_claim.what_it_covers: The ARCHIVED prunes with reason pruned_by_newer (79): for each, step4/matrix_cold scans whether a 'used' record's property premises were a name-subset of the pruned record's closure but NOT parameter-dischargeable (pf_trust.props.dischargeable). MEASURED name_only count = 0 (see matrix_cold.json loss_attribution.name_only_pruned_published). So no ARCHIVED published record was removed on a name-only (param-blind) basis.
name_only_pruned_published_claim.what_it_CANNOT_cover: Candidates discarded BEFORE being written as records (same_skeleton_worse, replace_blocked, always-true, duplicates) have NO persisted trace from the published run, so this claim does not and cannot speak to them. It is a statement about the 319 published records and the 231 archived propositions only.
name_only_pruned_published_claim.forward_fix: The v1.5 discard logger, when enabled (PF_DISCARD_LOG=<path>), records EVERY discard (stage, reason, decision inputs) so a future run has a complete trace. Per the HARD CONSTRAINT (no production generation run), v1.5 does NOT run production to backfill the gap; it ships the instrumented code and the fixture proving it logs (tests/test_generation_paths.py::test_discard_logger_records_every_discard).
